name: Parallel Voxel Carving on GPU
definition: A reconstruction method based on voxel-by-voxel carving, transformed into parallel GPU code where voxel carving for a group of voxels is independently executed in parallel.
summary: Parallel Voxel Carving on GPU reconstructs 3D volumes from depth maps using parallel thread assignment and a compact 8-byte data structure to minimize memory usage.
